entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I must say, {BaseGameText.Alphonso..."
entries.dialogueText: "I must say, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}, that was quite the adventure we just had. Never a dull moment with you around, eh?"

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That was quite an unexpected twist..."
entries.dialogueText: "That was quite an unexpected twist back there, Mr. President. I'd hoped to celebrate our deal with a drink, not a protest."

entries.dialogueText: "I have to admit, Mr. President, I didn't anticipate that our meeting would come to this particular end."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Your driver did a great job escort..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your driver did a great job escorting us out of there. He's a keeper."

entries.dialogueText: "But it seems we made the right choice. Your driver did a terrific job escorting us out of there."

entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Of course your driver had the righ..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course your driver had the right instincts. Escaping by helicopter was the safest choice for us both."

entries.title: Player: ""It was an adventure, wasn't it? An..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was an adventure, wasn't it? And I agree, Serge's assistance was invaluable."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, our safety matters most. But..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, our safety matters most. But it's unfortunate that we had to leave under those circumstances."

entries.dialogueText: "I can always rely on Serge to get me out of a dangerous situation."

entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it was unfortunate how the situation unfolded. But a stroke of luck that you had a helicopter at the ready."

entries.dialogueText: "A shame about the protests, but to be honest, I'm not sure we were ever going to see eye to eye. The only thing we can agree on is that Serge was right."

entries.speaker: Serge Wolkner
entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""Just doing my job, Mr. President...."
entries.dialogueText: "Just doing my job, Mr. President. I'm glad we're all safe."

entries.dialogueText: "Truly unfortunate, sir. But safety always comes first."

entries.title: Serge Wolkner: ""I'm just doing my job, Mr. Preside..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm just doing my job, Mr. President. Safety is top priority."

entries.dialogueText: "It's just a pity we couldn't tap into the potential of our meeting before all this... chaos."

entries.dialogueText: "The Gasom security and local police had been warning about potential armed gang activity in the area. It was best not to take any chances."

entries.dialogueText: "Once we were stuck in a traffic jam for hours, and he started singing old Sordish folk songs right there in the car. He had the whole motorcade laughing."

entries.dialogueText: "His stories could get even the most stone-faced security agents chuckling. I hope he was a good mentor to you, Serge."

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure your driving skills are top-notch, Serge. But a sense of humor can be just as important."

entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure you've got other hidden talents."

entries.speaker: Player

entries.dialogueText: "Do you have any stories for us, Serge?"

entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Mr. President. Nouman was quite a character. I do my best to serve in my own way."

entries.dialogueText: "It's important to forge your own path, Serge. I respect that."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Thank you for a stimulating discus..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for a stimulating discussion, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}. I have high hopes for Sordland's future, and for the continuation of the work we began during my presidency."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Thank you for your time, Mr. Presi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your time, Mr. President. I do hope that our discussion has given you some perspective."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It was a pleasure discussing these..."
entries.dialogueText: "It was a pleasure discussing these matters with you, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I didn't steer Gasom through tumul..."
entries.dialogueText: "I didn't steer Gasom through tumultuous times and lead Sordland through a critical phase of its history only to watch my legacy disintegrate. I trust you understand the stakes."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's not easy to run a country whi..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's not easy to run a country while preserving one's legacy. I trust that you will take our conversation to heart as you steer Sordland into the future."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Here's to a prosperous future for..."
entries.dialogueText: "Here's to a prosperous future for Sordland, Gasom, and the legacy we leave behind."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I look forward to seeing how your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I look forward to seeing how your decisions will shape our nation's future. We're fighting against the current, but I believe we can change the tide."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We will be in touch.""
entries.dialogueText: "We will be in touch."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not bumpy at all. I appreciate the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not bumpy at all. I appreciate the lift."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Their 15 percent stake is a fair d..."
entries.dialogueText: "Their 15 percent stake is a fair deal. But I believe we could attract even larger international investments if the EPA is removed. Imagine the potential if Rumburg joined in."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Don't forget that Rizia holds only..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't forget that Rizia holds only a minority stake and we still have control over Gasom."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""In business, a certain level of ri..."
entries.dialogueText: "In business, a certain level of risk is unavoidable. With the right safeguards, we can mitigate these risks."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Your confidence is reassuring. How..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your confidence is reassuring. However, how can we ensure that Rumburg won't attempt to gain more influence over time?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I share your views. However, I do..."
entries.dialogueText: "I share your views. However, I do worry about a potential backlash. The prospect of Rumburg buying a stake in our energy sector might not sit well with the public."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I am still concerned about the imp..."
entries.dialogueText: "I am still concerned about the implications of letting foreign entities have a stake in our energy sector. Isn't there a way to boost our economy without compromising our sovereignty?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""The changes we make to the Energy..."
entries.dialogueText: "The changes we make to the Energy Protection Act will have long-lasting implications for our nation's future. I can't decide this in a helicopter."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Take all the time you need, {BaseG..."
entries.dialogueText: "Take all the time you need, {BaseGameText.AlphonsoToPlayer}. These are not decisions to be made lightly."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""As I've said before, it's a matter..."
entries.dialogueText: "As I've said before, it's a matter of striking the right balance."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Public opinion is a vital factor,..."
entries.dialogueText: "Public opinion is a vital factor, Mr. President. However, in my experience, people often resist change initially."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""That's a risk we'll have to manage..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a risk we'll have to manage. Regular reviews and stringent regulations can help keep their influence in check."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Once they see the economic benefit..."
entries.dialogueText: "Once they see the economic benefits, they usually come around. We have to be transparent and communicate our intentions clearly."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Foreign investment can boost our e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Foreign investment can boost our economy, and as long as we ensure that our nation's interests are protected, I believe it's a risk worth taking."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I trust your judgement in making t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I trust your judgement in making the right call for our nation."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Rizia's 20 percent investment will..."
entries.dialogueText: "Rizia's 20 percent investment will keep us afloat for a while, but it won't be enough. Any further tightening of the EPA restrictions will spell disaster for Gasom, possibly even leading to bankruptcy."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""The question now is, how do we mov..."
entries.dialogueText: "The question now is, how do we move forward? And that's something we need to figure out together."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""We could consider other avenues li..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could consider other avenues like public-private partnerships or exploring new markets, but these options come with their own risks and uncertainties."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Our challenge is to control it, no..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our challenge is to control it, not let it control us."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's a bitter pill to swallow, kno..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a bitter pill to swallow, knowing that all of this could have been avoided."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Our resources are not infinite. We..."
entries.dialogueText: "Our resources are not infinite. We must prioritize, and sometimes, tough calls have to be made."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We have to remember the importance..."
entries.dialogueText: "We have to remember the importance of keeping our energy sector secure. The idea of Rumburg gaining significant influence is worrisome."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I understand the constraints you'r..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand the constraints you're under, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I share your concerns about Rumbur..."
entries.dialogueText: "I share your concerns about Rumburg, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""While I sympathize with your posit..."
entries.dialogueText: "While I sympathize with your position, the reality is that we had to make some hard choices."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I'm not sure if I trust your judge..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm not sure if I trust your judgement, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I just hope we can navigate throug..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just hope we can navigate through this and find a solution that doesn't jeopardize Gasom or Sordland."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""But I believe that with careful co..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I believe that with careful consideration, we can find a way forward."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""I just hope that we can find a sol..."
entries.dialogueText: "I just hope that we can find a solution that ensures Gasom's survival without compromising Sordland's interests."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""On the other hand, loosening those..."
entries.dialogueText: "On the other hand, loosening those restrictions too much will allow foreign entities like Rumburg to acquire a majority stake in Gasom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Mr. Alphonso, I'm aware of the gra..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Alphonso, I'm aware of the gravity of the situation. But we must not rush into decisions that could risk our sovereignty."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Indeed, Mr. President. We must not..."
entries.dialogueText: "Indeed, Mr. President. We must not be too hasty."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""It's a delicate situation, and the..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a delicate situation, and the decisions we make now will have lasting implications for our nation's future."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""At the very least, I ask you to co..."
entries.dialogueText: "At the very least, I ask you to consider increasing the foreign investment cap to 49%. It might not be the perfect solution, but it could provide the lifeline Gasom needs."

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""For old times' sake, let's work to..."
entries.dialogueText: "For old times' sake, let's work together to ensure Gasom doesn't become a casualty of our decisions."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's a compromise that could save..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's a compromise that could save Gasom without compromising our sovereignty too much. I'll consider it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Tightening the EPA laws further ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "Tightening the EPA laws further may be a necessary step for our future, even if it poses challenges for Gasom."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Not my decisions, Mr. Alphonso. Yo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not my decisions, Mr. Alphonso. Yours."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The low rumble of the helicopter's..."
entries.dialogueText: The low rumble of the helicopter's engines reverberated through the cabin as we soared over the vast expanse of Nargis.

entries.speaker: Ewald Alphonso
entries.title: Ewald Alphonso: ""Now that we've escaped an angry mo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now that we've escaped an angry mob together, may I call you Anton?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Of course, Ewald. You don't even n..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, Ewald. You don't even need to ask."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'd rather keep things on the prof..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'd rather keep things on the professional level, if you don't mind."
